query: SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT c.collection_id,c.object_id,o.object_data->>'type' AS type,o.object_data->>'actor' AS actor,o.created_at FROM activitypub_collection_item c JOIN activitypub_object o USING(object_id) WHERE c.collection_id LIKE '%did:key:z6MkuLKdSc7GHbgu9zDC8sZEjSbhAn7GzoHKXxsgsGNPakpB%' AND c.object_id LIKE '%did:key:z6MkprFq1ktAGdazKPpRaCJg11dHcRtjf8ZPXMvP3uauVw2f%' ORDER BY c.collection_id,c.object_id) t
